WITH october_charges AS (SELECT plan_type, COUNT(*) AS new_customers, SUM(charge_amount) AS revenue FROM charges WHERE DATE(charged_at) BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY plan_type), september_charges AS (SELECT plan_type, COUNT(*) AS new_customers, SUM(charge_amount) AS revenue FROM charges WHERE DATE(charged_at) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY plan_type), october_cancellations AS (SELECT plan_type, COUNT(*) AS churned_customers, SUM(charge_amount) AS churned_revenue FROM charges WHERE DATE(charged_at) BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' AND DATE(cancelled_at) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY plan_type), september_cancellations AS (SELECT plan_type, COUNT(*) AS churned_customers, SUM(charge_amount) AS churned_revenue FROM charges WHERE DATE(charged_at) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' AND DATE(cancelled_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY plan_type) SELECT o.plan_type, (o.churned_customers::FLOAT / o.new_customers) * 100 AS logo_churn_rate, (o.churned_revenue::FLOAT / o.revenue) * 100 AS revenue_churn_rate, (s.churned_customers::FLOAT / s.new_customers) * 100 AS logo_churn_rate_previous, (s.churned_revenue::FLOAT / s.revenue) * 100 AS revenue_churn_rate_previous FROM october_cancellations o JOIN september_cancellations s ON o.plan_type = s.plan_type JOIN october_charges oc ON o.plan_type = oc.plan_type JOIN september_charges sc ON s.plan_type = sc.plan_type;

WITH monthly_charges AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', charged_at) AS month, plan_type, COUNT(*) AS new_customers, SUM(charge_amount) AS revenue FROM charges GROUP BY month, plan_type), monthly_cancellations AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', charged_at) AS month, DATE_TRUNC('month', cancelled_at) AS cancellation_month, plan_type, COUNT(*) AS churned_customers, SUM(charge_amount) AS churned_revenue FROM charges WHERE cancelled_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month, cancellation_month, plan_type) SELECT mc1.month AS october, mc1.plan_type, (mc2.churned_customers::FLOAT / mc1.new_customers) * 100 AS logo_churn_rate, (mc2.churned_revenue::FLOAT / mc1.revenue) * 100 AS revenue_churn_rate, (mc3.churned_customers::FLOAT / mc4.new_customers) * 100 AS logo_churn_rate_previous, (mc3.churned_revenue::FLOAT / mc4.revenue) * 100 AS revenue_churn_rate_previous FROM monthly_charges mc1 JOIN monthly_charges mc4 ON mc1.plan_type = mc4.plan_type AND mc4.month = mc1.month - INTERVAL '1 month' JOIN monthly_cancellations mc2 ON mc1.month = mc2.cancellation_month AND mc1.plan_type = mc2.plan_type JOIN monthly_cancellations mc3 ON mc1.plan_type = mc3.plan_type AND mc3.cancellation_month = mc1.month - INTERVAL '1 month';
